page.overview:
Who is Cal Gerrico and Scabretto?

Cal Gerrico, a duellist, and his foul-smelling manservant Scabretto are two Tilean adventurers who rely more on luck than on skill to survive their misadventures.

Gerrico once abandoned his future wife Yolanda Catalli at the altar, but fate had it that they would meet again in the most absurd of ways.

They said to go east, that to the east, you would find fortune and glory, words enough to convince any son of Tilea. And so, Gerrico decided to cross the endless seas in search of riches and adventure. But he failed miserably. It seemed that Gerrico had trusted the wrong ship; it sank, but he and his faithful companion managed to escape in a lifeboat. With light hearts, knowing that the ship hadn’t been carrying women or children, they found themselves without food, condemned to certain death. Then, suddenly, a miracle—another ship spotted them and brought them aboard.

Unfortunately, the ship was part of a group of ill-intentioned pirates. However, Gerrico used his silver tongue to talk his way out of trouble. He asked to join the crew, but to do so, he would have to abide by the Pirate Code, which meant he had to face off against a crew member.
